book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Musibe wa Nibila Noorimela
Anamakoha-musoko ateene ni “anamathega” amohi yoomususedha Yesu wi emwiiwe.
MaFarizi ni anamasuuziha a malamulo yegi omwaaba, yiiraga: “Ola onowawaakela anamathega, ajaga vamohi ni aliwa.”
Vano Yesu ahaawogela musibe ola:
“Baani mwa nyo, oni aganna mabila zana, nirimeelavo nimohi, kanaahiye mukokolani makumi matanu na manayi nuudha matanu ni neenayi adhowa asayelaga nrimeelile ofiyedha ofwanya?
Agafwanyile, onothukula veefuddi ni odhaaliwa ohagalala.
Vano nuudhowa vade. Ahawiithana akwaaye ni amwaaddamani, awiirelaga: ‘Agalalani ni miyo, mwaha wowi gihifwanya nibila naaga narimeelile.’
Ginowuwaaddelani wi ni mukalelo mmohive, onokala ohagalala wulubale odhulu mwaha wa namathega mmohi onatthwaruwa, ohiyana makumi matanu na manayi ni atanu ni anayi ooharihamo ehinafuneya otthwaruwa.
Musibe wa Korowa Yoorimeela
“Naari mwihiyana baani, oni aganna korowa dha gwingwi kumi, arimeeliha emohi, kanahiddiha panti, azhela mba, asayelaga pama ofiyedha afwanya?
Vano, agafwanyile, onowaatugumanya akwaaye ni amwaaddamani, eeraga: ‘Agalalani ni miyo, mwaha wowi gihiddodda korowa yagirimeele.’
Miyo Ginowuwaaddelani wi ni mukalelo ola, onokala ohagalala vameentoni va angero a Mulugu mwaha wa namathega mmohi otthwaruwile.”
Musibe wa Mwaana Ooholowa
Yesu ahiwelelagave: “Mulobwana mmohi anna ahima abiili aalobwana.
Amung'onong'onoya mwa aliwa ahimwaaddela babaye, wiira: ‘Babani, mugigawele epaddi ya dhoreela dhigifwaneele.’ Oliye omugawelawo dhoreeladha.

“Vigavirile malabo ooyeva, muzombwe ole a mung'onong'onoya ahitugumanya dhego dhaaye dhatedhene, omaruwa, odhowa elabo emohiweene yoolapela. Wewo ahinoonga dhookalana dhaaye dhatedhene ni mukalelo wabure woohubuwelana dhoosogolo.
Agamalile onoonga dhaaye dhatedhene mwiilaboni mule, mwahidha dala yulubale, oliye wambeela okanna goyi.
Vano ahidhowa okala ni mulobwana mmohi a mwiilaboni mwemule, omuruma omidda waaye wi akameelege kumba dhaaye.
Wewule oofuna agarubalile maddeya yaaja kumba, mbwenye kaalivo amvaha maddeyaya.
“Ahubuwelela otthwaruwa, wiyiirela yeeka: ‘Anamalaba ababa enoja erubalaga mowaakwanana, miyo wuno gikwaga dala!
Baahi, ginovenya gidhowege wa babaga, gineere wawaaddela: Babani, gihittegela odhulu, ni vameentoni veenyu.
Vano kagifwaneelele wiiriwa mwaaninyu; mugaakele woona namalaba eenyu.’
Ahivenyaga odhowa wa babaye. “Adheelaga wolapelawene, babaye ahimoonaga, omweeddiwela thagaraga. Ahimuthamagelaga, omukubarela, ombezhari.
“Vano mwaana ahiiraga: ‘Babani, gihittegela odhulu, ni vameentoni veenyu. Vano kagifwaneelele wiiriwa mwaaninyu.’
“Babaye ahawaaddelaga anamalaba aaye: ‘Dhaanani mowaaguva yoowara yooriyesesa muwariheni, teto pethe mwimbunoni, sapatho omanyaloni.
Mmudhena mwana-ng'ombe ooruva, mumpe. Niirena mathanga, nihagalale.
Mwaha wowi mwaanaga ola ahikwa vano ohukanna egumi, ahirimeela, ohufwanyeya.’ Vano wambeela ohagalala.
“Mwaana a mulubale aaligi omidda. Awelagawo, aaddamelaga vade, eewilege wiiba ni wiina.
Omwiithana namalaba mmohi omukoha eneereya ddi.
Oliye omwaakula, wiira: ‘Ddibilawo didhiile, ababo waaruma wi epe mwana-ng'ombe yooruva, mwaha wowi ohumwaakela, aganna egumi.’
“Mwaana a mulubale otakaleliwa, kaafunaga ovolowa. Babaye ahikumelaga vade ombebeedhaga wi avolowe.
Mbwenye oliye ahawaakulaga babaye, wiira: ‘Vihivira yaaka dhijinjidhene guwiimelelagani gihilupile malamulo eenyu, mbwenye kamunagivahe naari mbuzi wi giirena mathanga ni akwaaga.
Mbwenye mwaninyu ola onoongile dhoreela dheenyu ni ahiyana oraruwa, muhumpela mwana-ng'ombe ooruva!’
“Vano babaye ahimwaakulaga: ‘Mwaanaga, we mudhidhi wateene onakala ni miyo, dhatedhene dhili dhaaga saawo.
Mbwenye yaali yoofuneya wi nihagalale, niteyele, mwaha wi ddibilo ola ahikwa vano ohukanna egumi, ahirimeela vano ohufwanyeya.’”
